phases: Phase 1: Evidence Synthesis (Entry: All source pack items received; Exit: Contradictions mapped and cited; Workstream: Evidence Mapping; Owner: Senior Architect; Artifacts: evidence_map_v1.txt, contradiction_log.txt; Dependencies: None; Coverage: Classical baseline, dense-retrieval result, zero-shot benchmark); Phase 2: Decision Leverage Analysis (Entry: Contradictions resolved with source pack keys; Exit: Sensitivity sub-object completed; Workstream: Sensitivity Mapping; Owner: Platform Lead; Artifacts: sensitivity_subobject.json, confidence_matrix.txt; Dependencies: Evidence Synthesis phase exit; Coverage: All decision levers tied to theme confidence); Phase 3: Risk Validation (Entry: Sensitivity sub-object finalized; Exit: Risk register approved; Workstream: Risk Assessment; Owner: Risk Officer; Artifacts: risk_register_v1.txt, early_warning_indicators.csv; Dependencies: Decision Leverage Analysis phase exit; Coverage: All identified risks with scales and mitigations); Phase 4: Final Review & Sign-off (Entry: Risk register signed off; Exit: Artifact approved for execution; Workstream: Final Validation; Owner: Program Manager; Artifacts: final_decision_log.txt, audit_checklist.json; Dependencies: Risk Validation phase exit; Coverage: All cross-cutting consistency points verified. Negative space: This plan excludes domain-specific feature development, operational rollout timelines, and third-party API integration decisions. No organizational policy or history is assumed.
critical_path: Hard dependency: Evidence Synthesis must complete before Decision Leverage Analysis begins; hard dependency: Decision Leverage Analysis must complete before Risk Validation starts; derived date: Phase 4 exit on 2023-10-15 (slip threshold: if delayed by more than 7 days, critical path recomputes); soft dependencies include cross-workstream artifact reviews and gap validations.
risk_register: Risk scale: Low (≤1.5), Medium (1.6–3.0), High (>3.0); Owner: Risk Officer; Mitigation: For high-risk items, trigger immediate review with source pack validation; Early-warning indicator: Any new contradiction in evidence_map_v1.txt or contradiction_log.txt triggers a re-evaluation of confidence matrix; All risks are tied to specific source keys and must be audited against the source pack for exact string match.
decision_log: Decision: Adopt hybrid routing with zero-shot fallback; basis: [source_key: zero_shot_benchmark_03] shows 89% recall at 1.5% cost, [source_key: dense_retrieval_result_02] shows 76% precision under domain shift; counter-evidence: [source_key: classical_baseline_01] reports 42% drop in performance when domain shifts; what the pack cannot resolve: The exact threshold for zero-shot reliability under unseen domains is undefined; Decision: Retain engineering cost study as baseline but defer final routing choice until reranking economics note is reviewed; basis: [source_key: reranking_economics_note_01] shows 2.3x cost increase at scale, [source_key: engineering_cost_study_04] indicates feasible implementation at 85% capacity; counter-evidence: No domain shift data in engineering cost study; what the pack cannot resolve: The impact of domain shift on reranking economics is not quantified.
